voice_085:r_77949221bf58f862.text: Can I do this...? No, I have to!

voice_085:r_9fcb3754cb1773c7.text: At last, this day has come!

voice_085:r_3559d2fad32c2435.text: Gundams make my old wounds ache...!

voice_085:r_f7570547e9f80a64.text: Chance to down a Gundam\nat last...!

voice_085:r_cbab0f4720e1fcf1.text: A Gundam is still\na mobile suit!

voice_085:r_0bbe0b4f5364e732.text: Devil! We meet again in battle!

voice_085:r_5dda5198137cb02a.text: Hear our cries of hatred, Gundam!

voice_085:r_83ec59afbecdec14.text: What can a fake Gundam do!

voice_085:r_0f58a8822381e57f.text: Break those wings\nand slam you down!

voice_085:r_4a9ac1dff86506d9.text: My skill can close the power gap!

voice_085:r_bc8538e6af3d2577.text: I should have the edge in agility!

voice_085:r_da1174533722333f.text: Attacking in such a weak machine...!

voice_085:r_6b15af9a0057cdc8.text: You and I are both dogs of war!

voice_085:r_ac6fe7838e95647b.text: Take out their ace and crush morale!

voice_085:r_77ca87eacd17ad52.text: We survived this long\nfor a reason!

voice_085:r_bf3244994760e535.text: Crush their leader to seize victory!

voice_085:r_a2df00f91a9b0a9e.text: So young... Your moves give it away!

voice_085:r_48b60d6c48b9b142.text: To some brat with no resolve...!

voice_085:r_a77f4913375098d2.text: I won't let you get cockier!

voice_085:r_428c2116ac3071b1.text: I won't let this chance get away!

voice_085:r_84c116267b79f540.text: I'll finish you with this counter!

voice_085:r_dad38ee29af2df3a.text: I'll repay you, once and for all!

voice_085:r_69dfa1659715e2fa.text: Time to show them Zeon's spirit!

voice_085:r_546de3fb6db156ea.text: I'll go as often as it takes!

voice_085:r_ca85f87cee5e31f7.text: Too slow! Here comes another hit!

voice_085:r_9072ea7bc71df136.text: The rest... is up to you...!

voice_085:r_3c5b0c2ac812d5de.text: Seems... I won't make it back...

voice_085:r_7bea3023abbf8a94.text: I-Is this as far as I go!?

voice_085:r_c958860b0676b1f5.text: This is the White Devil, or worse!

voice_085:r_7847e0ed7dc9282d.text: So strong...! A true latest model!

voice_085:r_e42b52c7a987b906.text: I can't even beat a fake Gundam!?

voice_085:r_6825fd1ff907bd22.text: Even the GMs have been upgraded...!

voice_085:r_132f605d02975e71.text: I can't keep up...!\nCould it be...!?

voice_085:r_9b9726b1872759d6.text: No! That sheer power will crush me!

voice_085:r_1252db29683fefe0.text: Ngh! I can't match that speed!

voice_085:r_ad3d538f1e909184.text: I dismissed it as small, and now...!

voice_085:r_aba6a7662129d8ce.text: Power and drive... Is this youth!?

voice_085:r_c8c59db85bf875e6.text: Whoa!? Is that thing a monster!?

voice_085:r_391aa56435d9dd6e.text: I-I won't let you! I won't!

voice_085:r_fa944da4b6519006.text: Still moving...! I can still fight!

voice_085:r_bdd38c584fa313d0.text: If need be, I'll die in a charge!

voice_085:r_3fd86c1027f317c8.text: Retreat would waste my ten years!

voice_085:r_d0372a183d2007ad.text: As long as it moves, I'll fight on!

voice_085:r_381992c5d8224937.text: No retreat! I'll fight to the end!

voice_085:r_cf7dbf49e96a5755.text: Ngh...! That was careless of me!

voice_085:r_fa96676cc65bb509.text: My way of fighting doesn't work...!?

voice_085:r_4e37f92e7d2fc62e.text: Old model or not, I still...!

voice_085:r_66ab4cfe1557909d.text: Damn you! Don't think this is over!

voice_085:r_0bad405ee6ca63ba.text: Can't keep taking hits like this...!

voice_085:r_2072eaf71a260ae7.text: As feared,\nthe power gap's too wide!

voice_085:r_6c13bbfd27a7799e.text: Any slower and I'd be dead...!

voice_085:r_06f88dcbd3c9e738.text: This one's bold...! A tough foe!

voice_085:r_b28faf9f71bc3598.text: My controls haven't been hit yet!

voice_085:r_8a29278549f8e07a.text: Damn it! I'm no stepping stone!

voice_085:r_7e6c573c26177f98.text: A Gundam alone won't win this!

voice_085:r_45abf84f7757d6eb.text: The Gundam legend is history now!

voice_085:r_edd7a13ab8f06a14.text: You're nowhere near the White Devil!

voice_085:r_8165e5b41f0124c4.text: So much for the latest model!

voice_085:r_4e05581b7432cce8.text: A fake is still just a fake!

voice_085:r_eb643f8bf737a0ca.text: Pilot ruled by speed\nis no good...!

voice_085:r_0a3fccb71ec6cf2a.text: Weak as it looks, after all!

voice_085:r_9b63cf1f3e0207ef.text: You brat! Run home to your mommy!

voice_085:r_1d6d784036ae0bd7.text: At least my armor stopped it...!

voice_085:r_625664af02183c17.text: Doesn't look like much of an enemy!

voice_085:r_38e4a434c91d8ef0.text: A scratch or two means nothing now!

voice_085:r_98ed411352a3a6ac.text: That attack won't stop my charge!

voice_085:r_4824bea6bab3af67.text: You're only skilled at cheap tricks!

voice_085:r_b5f5a97ed82acb0b.text: We're both still in active service!

voice_085:r_d9cd2e4ded064396.text: Missed...! The tide's turned my way!

voice_085:r_99e6349431aaf23b.text: The machine's worse, but I'm better!

voice_085:r_76d1e51c8b494a60.text: You won't hit me that easily!

voice_085:r_eb5f687fcd372ae7.text: Power means nothing if you miss!

voice_085:r_2329428a6871d9fa.text: I'll block it with my shield!

voice_085:r_efa71f7a4cc33ff3.text: Can't rely on my shield forever...!

voice_085:r_82c09f011d703b2c.text: Tch! I let the perfect chance slip!

voice_085:r_2b4d8818c77b6dca.text: Damn! I'm a sitting duck like this!

voice_085:r_099e2458cabf796f.text: An attack from beyond my range...!

voice_085:r_fd910d714be70870.text: So I'm out of energy too...!

voice_085:r_9736f29b11344ec3.text: Regroup while I have the chance!

voice_085:r_fcd05582aa5c6068.text: I won't let you have your way!

voice_085:r_bece29562818acba.text: Some glory can only be won alive!

voice_085:r_494b5da92ed24ecb.text: If Shambro falls, our plan fails!

voice_085:r_cd06d0820d82524b.text: If I grapple you at close range...!!

voice_085:r_c94c6d04be583774.text: Melee combat is won by experience!

voice_085:r_e54e2c99ef8297af.text: I'll show you\nreal MS melee combat!

voice_085:r_f16a3eb0bcaac082.text: I'll hit your power unit directly!

voice_085:r_bc7b9e308b879dd4.text: Either my barrel melts or you fall!

voice_085:r_bf953d64c3c7d9b7.text: I'll take you down for sure!

voice_085:r_e09b933e3e706779.text: If we bring our numbers to bear...!

voice_085:r_66236eb99b676e5b.text: I'll focus on pinning them down!

voice_085:r_2502132569141ea3.text: If only our numbers were even!
